entries.34b50c12fac0d23b: This is consulting specialised in improving the quality of embedded software. Its feature is a one-stop style in which the consultants themselves put the proposed measures into practice and handle problem-solving directly; centred on modeling technology, in the automotive field it supports the introduction of model-based development, compliance with functional safety and similar matters. The amount is not disclosed separately.
entries.35d9db805ef22878: A consulting company that handles quality improvement of embedded software, from proposal to implementation, mainly for the automotive industry.
entries.6ac60c7924815065: Manufacturers of robots and digital devices
entries.75e56c7aec952e27: This is a human resource development business providing training services on the engineering methods used by the company group and the online learning platform 'Eureka Box (Yūrika Bokkusu)'. The amount is not disclosed separately.
entries.a5bfd8cbe8454e96: This is the single segment of the company group. The company provides consulting that handles everything from proposal to problem-solving in one stop, centred on improving the quality of embedded software incorporated into products such as automobiles, robots and digital devices. Revenue for the fiscal year ended November 2025 was ¥1,386 million. The group consists of two companies: the company and its consolidated subsidiary, bubo Co., Ltd. The head office (Shinagawa-ku, Tokyo), the Nagoya Project Room and the Osaka office are all business sites of the single segment, so they cover this business as a whole.
entries.ba40b4952c3e950d: This is a solution that applies generative AI to consulting based on professional expertise, responding to needs for both high quality and high productivity. The amount is not disclosed separately.
entries.c57a2cec6b026537: This is a tool business providing the requirements definition support service 'CoBrain (Koburein)', which uses generative AI. The amount is not disclosed separately.
